hero_landing_living_organism.visual_concept: Full-bleed generative HTML5 Canvas organism breathing in real-time behind the UI. Connected nodes represent active people and chains across Somalia/diaspora. Filaments pulsing with light particles feed off SSE real-time events.

canvas_specs.filament_style: Bezier quadratic S-curves with gradient stroke (cyan #00F0FF to lime #00FF66) and opacity oscillation (0.2 to 0.7)
canvas_specs.pulse_particles: Glowing spheres traveling along S-curves at 1.5px/frame with radial glow bloom radius of 12px
canvas_specs.idle_motion: Perlin-noise / sine wave drift giving a floating, breathing organism motion (0.3px/s drift)
canvas_specs.realtime_sse_trigger: When SSE emits 'join_event', spawn 12 high-velocity cyan/lime explosion particles at target city coordinates, trailing a bright filament to the root chain node.
canvas_specs.low_end_android_performance: Auto FPS detect: If frame rate drops below 28 FPS, reduce particle count by 50% and switch to simple linear line drawing without shadow blur.

cinematic_join_reveal_sequence.concept: A 5-beat full-screen overlay celebration modal triggered immediately upon submitting nickname. Transforms joining from a boring form submission into an unforgettable, shareable initiation ritual.

beat_timeline.name: The Flash Implosion
beat_timeline.effect: Background darkens, modal content scales down to 0.95 with cyan radial shockwave expanding across the viewport.

beat_timeline.name: Spark Number Ignition
beat_timeline.effect: Dramatically count up from 0 to Spark #N (e.g., Spark #1,482) in large glowing JetBrains Mono type with pitch-escalating micro audio clicks.
beat_timeline.ui_element: You are Spark #<AnimatedCounter value={sparkNumber} /> in the <BranchName />

beat_timeline.name: Aura & Sigil Reveal
beat_timeline.effect: Generated chain Sigil spins into place with glowing neon outline and aura color gradient ring burst.

beat_timeline.name: City Network Lighting
beat_timeline.effect: Target city node (e.g. 'Garowe, Puntland') lights up with pulsating wave radar rings extending outward.

beat_timeline.name: Instant Share Launchpad
beat_timeline.effect: Action panel slides up with pre-filled WhatsApp link, copy link CTA, and personal referral QR card.
beat_timeline.ui_element: Buttons: 'Share to WhatsApp Now' + 'Copy My Personal Link'

tartan_aura_and_sigil_generator.concept: Every Tartan chain gets a deterministic, distinct visual identity (Aura color pair + Sacred Geometry SVG Sigil + Custom Title styling) based on string hashing of chain ID / name.

sigil_svg_algorithm.central_shape: Polygons generated via trigonometric points based on hash char code modulo (3-sided triangle, 6-sided hexagon, 8-sided starburst)
sigil_svg_algorithm.orbit_rings: Concentric dashed SVG circles rotating in opposite directions at 20s/rev
sigil_svg_algorithm.rune_glyphs: Custom geometric vector strokes (S-curves, lightning zigzags, diamond nodes) rendered in primary neon stroke

personal_ripple_visualization_and_share.concept: A personal organic radial graph showing 'YOU' at the epicenter of your own downstream human network.

ripple_viz_layout.center_node: Your Avatar + Nickname with pulsating lime ring ('YOU / Epicenter')
ripple_viz_layout.tier_1_ring: Direct joins connected by solid glowing S-curves with city labels
ripple_viz_layout.tier_2_plus: Downstream branch nodes rendered as tiny glowing star particles radiating outwards
ripple_viz_layout.spreader_rank_badge:
You are Rank # Super-Spreader in this chain (Top

%)
ripple_viz_layout.canvas_or_svg: Dynamic SVG with Framer Motion spring physics on drag/touch

shareable_milestone_card.style: Cinematic 16:9 or 4:5 vertical poster card with dark glass background, neon border glow, custom chain sigil, spark count, and bold QR code.
shareable_milestone_card.export_action: Instant PNG download via html2canvas / SVG render or native navigator.share image payload

micro_interactions_and_delight_details.entrance_stagger: Container variants: { animate: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.07 } } }, Item variants: { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 16 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }
micro_interactions_and_delight_details.live_pulse_badge: Flex row with pinging green dot (relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5 + animate-ping absolute bg-lime-400 rounded-full) + text: 'LIVE SSE SYNAPSE ACTIVE'
micro_interactions_and_delight_details.copy_feedback_toast: Sonner toast with glowing cyan checkmark and haptic feedback trigger

component_art_direction.Header.jsx: Sticky header (z-50) with glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070B14]/80 border-b border-cyan-500/20`. Brand title in Unbounded font with glowing cyan dot. Includes live node counter badge and language toggle switch (EN/SO).
component_art_direction.Home.jsx: Living hero section containing LivingChainCanvas, prominent 'Ignite Your Spark' CTA, Flagship Puntland campaign highlight banner, multi-chain bento grid, and real-time global map preview.
component_art_direction.JoinModal.jsx: Dark glass dialog (`bg-[#0B101D]/90 border border-cyan-500/40 backdrop-blur-2xl`) with step 1 nickname input and step 2 city select, transitioning straight into the Cinematic Join Reveal Sequence.
component_art_direction.LineageView.jsx: Interactive horizontal/vertical lineage tree with S-curve connectors, glowing active nodes, avatar badges, and time depth indicators.
component_art_direction.ChainMap.jsx: Interactive Leaflet/Canvas map with dark tiles (`https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png`), neon city markers (Garowe, Bosaso, Galkayo, Mogadishu, Hargeisa, London, Dubai, Minneapolis) and glowing bezier arc connections between nodes.
component_art_direction.SharePanel.jsx: Share actions drawer with instant WhatsApp share button (`bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500`), SMS button (`bg-blue-600`), Copy link with visual ripple feedback, and QR modal trigger.
component_art_direction.StartTartanDialog.jsx: Chain creation dialog featuring live Aura/Sigil preview generator as user types chain title, title input, description, optional target city, and 'Launch Chain' button.
component_art_direction.MeDashboard.jsx: Personal spreader stats (Direct Joins, Total Downstream, Personal Reach Map, Spreader Rank badge) and personal ripple visualization.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language switches, copy actions, share buttons, map controls, dialog triggers) MUST have a unique data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read and apply all visual specifications, motion timelines, and art direction rules from this design_guidelines.json file into the React components.
2. Maintain dark neon palette (#070B14 background, #00F0FF cyan, #00FF66 lime, #FFB800 amber) with glassmorphism overlays (backdrop-blur-xl).
3. Ensure LivingChainCanvas provides a smooth 60fps responsive background experience with lightweight particle fallback for low-end mobile browsers.
4. Implement the Cinematic Join Reveal sequence upon submitting nickname in JoinModal.
5. Use ChainSigil algorithm to give every Tartan chain a unique aura color pair and sacred geometry SVG sigil.
6. Include personal ripple visualization in MeDashboard and personal share drawer.
7. Attach kebab-case data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
